Basic Information.Others: The Nintendo Switch The Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom Edition Gaming Console is a limited edition Nintendo Switch OLED Model with a design inspired by the upcoming video game The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.
Basic Information.Special Feature: The system includes two Joy-Con controllers with green and gold hues and Legend of Zelda insignia, as well as a glossy white dock with the Hylian Crest and other game icons in gold.
Basic Information.Storage: 64 GB of internal storage for saving your games
Basic Information.Feature: 7-inch OLED screen with vibrant colors and strong contrast, as well as a broad adjustable stand that lets you play comfortably in tabletop mode.

Connectivity.Connectivity: The console contains a dock with a wired LAN connector for a solid internet connection in TV mode
